title: People’s Mañanera November 25
author: Pedro Gellert
content:
_Every day, President Claudia Sheinbaum gives a morning presidential press
conference and Mexico Solidarity Media posts English language summaries,
translated by Mexico Solidarity 's Pedro Gellert. Previous press conference
summaries are available [here](https://mexicosolidarity.com/mananera/)._

**November 25: The 4T Constitutionally Enshrined Women’s Right to Live Free
from Violence  
** President Claudia Sheinbaum kicked off 16 Days of Activism with a guide
against digital violence and 12 commitments from Men for Transformation. She
will present a family justice bill and called on the Senate to pass the law
against femicides. 27 million Mexican women receive pensions,
scholarships/stipends, housing assistance, or counseling. In 2027, an
additional 500 LIBRE Community Centers will be opened.

**Decent Housing in the Upper and Lower Mountain Regions of Guerrero  
** The Master Plan will benefit 1,833 women and 758 men with 40,000 pesos
(US$2,087) per family through the Banco del Bienestar. With technical
guidance, each family decides whether to improve roofs, floors, or facilities.
Guerrero has provided nearly 7,000 grants in two years.

**The President on the INE’s Córdova: They Didn’t Do What They Were Supposed
to Do  
** Former National Electoral Institute (INE) president Lorenzo Córdova said
the state never regulated the concentration of suppliers of election
materials, and Sheinbaum reminded him that the INE could always have opened up
competition. “If you’ve always hired one company and in the next bidding
guideline you state, ‘only companies with experience may participate,’ then
you’ve already rigged the bidding process,” she explained.
